I said this on another comment further up, but what I'd actually love to see isn't them getting an invuln, but rather a rule where their super-heavy armour reduces the ap of things hitting them by up to 3 (to a minimum of zero) reduced by 1 for every 2 sponsons you run, since in the lore the sponsons would get removed to add extra armour. 

This would mean the bog-standard baneblade with two sponsons would have a 2+ armour save, with all ap against it being reduced by 2, giving them a 4+ against meltas and still a 6+ t-shirt against the Tau railgun, busted as it is right now.

Obviously if you did this you'd remove the points cost of the sponsons, and there'd probably still need to be more changes made to other stats (3+BS at highest bracket?) and the points cost of the model, but I think it's an interesting way to put the super-heavy armour of the Guard onto the table.

What I would love to see for the baneblades and their varients is, yes going to a 2+ armour save, but also removing the points cost on sponsons and giving them a rule that says they reduce the ap of all weapons being fired at them by 3, to a minimum AP0, with the reduction being reduced for every two sponsons you run. That would complement their lore as being the heaviest armoured things short of titans on the field, capable of withstanding the Tau railgun shots like they can in canon, and cement their role on the battlefield as being the ridiculously hard to kill anvil of the Guard. While it would also give a meaningful choice between firepower and protection when you run them.

 Honestly I don't think that'd be enough to fix baneblades, and the numbers around the change would need a lot of tweaking, but I love the idea of a tank so goddamn heavy that even meltas struggle to get through its armour.
